description: Creates a new game (a draft listing) in the account. kind "web" (default) is an HTML5 game played on Gamealia; kind "mobile" is a free showcase listing for a downloadable Android/iOS game that has no web version: it needs storeLinks, has no build, upload, autotest or ads (so no revenue share), and every change is reviewed by a person before it is public. Needs a slug and at least an English title and description; texts accept several locales ({en, es, ...}) and more locales can be added with update_listing. ageRating describes the game's content and is required to submit.

adsEnabled.description: Show Gamealia ads in this game (revenue share; default true)

ageRating.description: Minimum recommended age, required to submit; judge it from the game's real content and tell the developer. all: nothing violent or scary; 7: mild cartoon violence; 12: non-graphic or fantasy combat, weapons, zombies, horror, mild language; 16: intense or realistic combat, blood, strong language. Guns, explosives and horror are 12 at least. Sexual or suggestive content, gore, hate, real-money gambling and other adult content are not allowed at any rating.

backendHosts.description: The developer's own servers the game talks to, e.g. mp.example.com or *.example.com

controls.description: How to play: keys, mouse, touch, 0-500 characters: an English string, or an object of locale -> text such as {"en": "...", "es": "..."}

description.description: What the game is and why it is fun, 20-2000 characters: an English string, or an object of locale -> text such as {"en": "...", "es": "..."}

isolation.description: coop-coep only for builds that need SharedArrayBuffer (threads)

jamCode.description: Made at a game jam: the jam site's code the developer was given (e.g. JAM27-ROS, shown on the site's page at gamealia.app/jams). The game then also shows on that jam site's page and goes first in review. null removes it. Only set it when the developer gave you a code.

kind.description: web (default): playable HTML5 build. mobile: store-links listing of an Android/iOS game without a web build (multiplayer, adsEnabled, isolation, backendHosts and permissions do not apply). Fixed once created

multiplayer.description: Players per room and the room features the code really supports, or null for single player (see get_docs {slug: "multiplayer"})

orientation.description: Screen orientation the game needs (default any)

permissions.description: Browser permissions the game needs ([] removes them); takes effect when a version tested with it is approved

permissionsJustification.description: Why the game needs `permissions`, for the reviewer (10-1000 characters); required when adding one

slug.description: URL name, 3-40 of a-z 0-9 -, also the game's own host <slug>.gamealia.app (cannot change once live)

storeLinks.description: Mobile listings only: where players download the game. Only the official https Google Play / App Store app links (other parameters are dropped). null or "" removes a store, a missing key keeps it. At least one is needed to submit. Refused for web games.

tags.description: 1-6 categories (genres), up to 8 mechanics (match-3, merge, physics, tower-defense, ...) and attributes (multiplayer, mobile, ...) in one array

texts.description: Developer-written listing text per locale, many at once: {"fr": {"title", "description", "controls"}, "de": {...}}. Locales: en, es, pt-BR, fr, de, it, ru, tr, ja, ko, zh-CN, zh-TW, id, pl, nl, ar, hi, vi, th, uk, cs, ro, hu, sv, el, he, fi, da, nb, ms, fil, bn. Only given fields change; {} approves that locale's machine translation; null removes it. Translate the listing yourself into every locale (same meaning and tone, keep proper nouns).

title.description: Game title, 2-60 characters: an English string, or an object of locale -> text such as {"en": "...", "es": "..."}

name: create_game
title: Create a game listing
